items.title: Жилые острова · внутри тора
items.description: Крупные жилые острова окружают широкую зелёную зону. Дальняя поверхность с дорожками и зданиями плавно поднимается по внутренней стороне огромного тора. Детализация, количество мелких построек, озеленение и подсветка сокращены по замечанию автора задания.
items.canon_status: Предложение адаптации. Тороидальная геометрия и масштаб не установлены текстом романа.
items.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached concept of the ceramic residential islands INSIDE A HUGE TOROIDAL SHIP. The user rejects the excessive small details, repetitive tiny buildings, vegetation clutter and visual noise. Make a dramatically CLEANER, more composed and quieter architectural version of this same space. The transformation must be obvious at first glance.

KEEP: the enormous scale; ivory and very pale celadon faceted rounded ceramic architecture with recessed inhabited windows; a small number of children and unobtrusive care robots; the inhabited landscape curving gently UPWARD toward the far horizon inside the torus; the same slightly elevated oblique wide view and believable high enclosing spacecraft shell. Foreground almost level, distant land rises continuously along the ring. This is the physical ground bending, not merely the roof. Do not flatten the world.

SIMPLIFY THE COMPOSITION to a handful of bold masses and broad calm negative spaces. Show FIVE LARGE distinctive residential islands total in the readable foreground and midground, each with two or three continuous recessed horizontal window bands and broad uninterrupted ceramic surfaces. One large cropped island at left, one long low island at right, two intermediate islands framing a common green, one distant landmark. Buildings feel substantial and inhabited, not tiny identical bungalows. Beyond those, only two or three extremely subtle distant architectural bands dissolve into atmospheric haze. REMOVE the dense carpet of dozens/hundreds of small duplicated buildings up the horizon.

At least 65 percent of the visible ground is CONTINUOUS CLOSE-CUT GREEN LAWN, in two or three very large open shapes. A broad gently S-curved pale concrete pedestrian path connects the islands and continues up the toroidal horizon; only two short branches and ONE restrained elevated connecting bridge. No spaghetti of promenades, many crossings or tiny inset landscape pockets. Retain one small simple circular still fountain as an understated focal point in the common green. Plant only two compact, deliberately grouped groves of low citrus trees at the edges, and sparse low clipped planting. REMOVE the forest of spiky cypress trees, all multicoloured flower borders, busy rooftop jungles, tiny planters, decorative rocks, furniture clutter and foreground foliage blocking the composition. Roof gardens become smooth low green surfaces.

Simplify the spacecraft enclosure to enormous calm pale panels with a few widely spaced structural ribs and ONE soft broad artificial daylight band following the torus. Remove the dense grid of little glowing ceiling squares and thin gold edge strips everywhere. Neutral soft daylight, restrained warm light inside a few windows; lower saturation and microcontrast, matte ceramic and concrete, fresh muted greens, subtle sky-like distance. Approx 12–18 tiny child figures across this enormous scene and two small robots, no adult people, no crowd. The architectural spaces remain visually rich through proportion, volume, shadow, curvature and openness, not ornament or fine detail. High-end cinematic architectural visualization with crisp broad forms and understated texture, not a schematic, not a miniature, not a glossy shopping mall. Landscape 16:9. No text, labels or watermarks. Priority: radically reduce visual noise while preserving the beautiful ceramic island identity, the enormous inhabitable toroidal world and the clearly ascending distant ground.

items.title: Жилые острова · детский город
items.description: Вместо разрозненных зданий на больших газонах — связный детский город: общественный центр, активные нижние этажи, библиотека, мастерские, игровые террасы и переходы. Сохраняются крупные спокойные формы и подъём пространства по внутренней стороне тора.
items.canon_status: Предложение адаптации. Геометрия, масштаб и конкретная архитектурная организация не установлены текстом романа.
items.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: cinematic architectural concept for ALIVE / MOAG. Substantially redesign the attached toroidal habitat image following this new art direction. The user says the current scene looks like an empty sanatorium: isolated residential blocks on empty lawns. They want FUTURISTIC URBAN SPATIAL ORGANISATION that feels like PARADISE FOR CHILDREN, while retaining clean composition and avoiding the previous visual noise.

KEEP the identity of ivory / pale celadon faceted ceramic residential architecture, recessed warm window bands, enormous enclosing ship shell, artificial daylight, and the very important gently concave LANDSCAPE THAT BENDS UP toward the far horizon inside a gigantic torus. Foreground remains almost level, the urban districts and landscape climb continuously along the inner ring in the distance. Maintain immense scale and atmospheric depth. All human inhabitants are CHILDREN and young teenagers, approximately ages 7–15, with a few friendly practical service robots. No adult humans or families.

REPLACE the scattered resort blocks with a highly legible, medium-density, walkable FUTURISTIC CHILDREN'S CITY. The composition has a strong hierarchy:
1. ONE generous oval civic common in the lower-middle frame, framed by inhabited building edges rather than lawns on every side. It combines a broad green play meadow on one half and a pale mineral social plaza on the other, with wide integrated steps and places to sit. Keep the centre visibly open and uncluttered.
2. THREE distinct but connected neighbourhood clusters wrap around this common and recede along the torus. Each cluster consists of two or three substantial 4–6 storey ceramic buildings with varied heights and continuous inhabited facades, arranged into partially enclosed courts and sheltered pedestrian lanes. Avoid an endless repeated grid. Buildings relate to each other and form spatial rooms, small squares, doorways and shortcuts; no freestanding hotel pavilions separated by vast empty lawns.
3. ONE broad continuous pedestrian promenade draws a clear S-shaped route through the civic common and up toward the rising horizon. At ground level, it passes real active entrances, open workshop rooms, shared dining spaces, a library / quiet reading arcade and transparent learning studios. These are spaces children can independently inhabit, not retail shops or restaurant terraces.
4. TWO generously protected elevated pedestrian bridges connect neighbourhood roof terraces at purposeful junctions. Combine stairs with visible lift cores and gently sloping accessible routes. One bridge widens into a collective lookout / meeting terrace. These help the city read as futuristic layered urbanism, without a tangle of bridges.

PLAY IS PART OF THE ARCHITECTURE: compose one sculptural landform play zone along the edge of the common, with integrated smooth slide slopes and climbing hollows; a contained skating / wheeled-play loop on the outer plaza edge; and a small shallow interactive water ribbon where children gather. Put a robotics / making workshop behind one broad ground-floor opening and a quiet citrus courtyard in the next neighbourhood. These different activities should be immediately readable as TWO OR THREE well-organised destination zones, not a scatter of toy equipment. No gigantic toys, castles, carousel, carnival, amusement-park branding or ball-pit aesthetic. The dream comes from the children's freedom to explore, invent, play, gather and find quieter places, supported by beautiful civic architecture.

Show roughly 35–45 children in varied natural SMALL GROUPS distributed at the actual activity destinations: some moving through the promenade, some playing in the common, some gathered at a workshop and on the overlook. A few service robots. No evenly spaced decorative people, no packed crowds. Trees are gathered in two or three deliberate compact groves, with low roof gardens; broad grass areas remain but occupy about a third of the ground, not most of it. The foreground includes a short readable section of an inhabited street and active building base to establish urban life.

VISUAL DISCIPLINE: bold legible architectural volumes, clean smooth ceramic surfaces, calm large plant masses, a few restrained teal and muted coral functional accents. Soft neutral artificial daylight with gently warm rooms, subtle shadows, no excessive edge lighting, glittering windows, flower carpets, tiny repeated facade decorations or busy machinery. Simplified great roof panels and widely spaced load-bearing ribs. The scene must look rich in SPACE, HUMAN ACTIVITY AND ORGANISATION, not rich in ornamental detail. Eye-catching clear architectural composition, one dominant civic space, three substantial neighbourhood masses, readable depth and toroidal upward curvature. Cinematic photoreal concept art, 16:9 wide frame, no labels, diagram overlays, text or watermarks.
